svg.title: The cost of checking and the results that remain open
svg.desc: Measured component medians and interquartile ranges, not confidence intervals or end-to-end speedups. First-crossing cost covers three thresholds; matrix exponential includes at least 33 evaluations. Base path-law cost is per baseline, while rerouting and gap/bound costs are per pair. The final near-boundary category is a deliberately difficult control, separate from the formal benchmark. Zeros are verified stored counts, not replacements for missing or interrupted runs.
svg.title: The cost of checking and the results that remain open
